pages.title: Wings Without Dawn
pages.text: Charged equipment unlocks flight with its own limits.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeat Forsaken for Pure Darkness and convert it to Shadow Silk. A Gloomoth sacrifice creates Watcher; Vesper creates Forsaken. Wear hood/cloak together; darkness charges them and Darkened Apple extends active state.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Charge the darkness set and fly in shadow mode. Defeat Forsaken for Pure Darkness and convert it to Shadow Silk. A Gloomoth sacrifice creates Watcher; Vesper creates Forsaken. Wear hood/cloak together; darkness charges them and Darkened Apple extends active state.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Charge the darkness set and fly in shadow mode. Defeat Forsaken for Pure Darkness and convert it to Shadow Silk. A Gloomoth sacrifice creates Watcher; Vesper creates Forsaken. Wear hood/cloak together; darkness charges them and Darkened Apple extends active state.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use two different techniques: delayed dagger, Dreadbow volley or Burrowing Arrow. The dagger leaves a delayed spectral strike. Shadow-Silk Dreadbow rains a volley; Corrodent-teeth Burrowing Arrows mine a limited number of blocks. Teeth also brew Haste.
